text.p: First Merchants Acceptance Corp said Wednesday it completed a $144.7 million asset securitization through the sale of automobile receivables-backed notes and certificates.
Of these securities, $101 milion Class A-1 notes have a floating rate and $37.9 million Class A-2 notes have a fixed rate of 6.15 percent.
In addition, $5.8 million of asset-backed certificates were issued with a fixed rate of 6.35 percent.
First Merchants, a specialty finance company, said use of an owner trust structure in this transaction enables it to offer multiple, sequential-pay securities and to prefund a portion of the trust.
"This is our sixth successfully completed securitization in just over a year, totaling more than $600 million," said president Mitchell Kahn.
